==gimste==
*Currently, Simple English definitions in jbopvlaste are being reused by me for La Bangu dictionary. The changes are removing "by standard" places for most (but not all) smuvelcki where they exist, strictly specifying what tersumti what sumti type can accept.
*gimste must clearly specify sumti types.
**currently known sumti types: object, nu, ka, du'u, sedu'u, si'o, quote, lu'a-concept, li, ma'oi, ra'oi
*gimste must clearly specify sumti interactions ala gua\spi (e.g. x3+1,2)
*Changing the order or places is not planned except when the corpus strongly suggests the opposite and/or leads to misusage. ({traji3=traji4}, {mabla}, {zabna} are examples).
==lujvo, rafsi, fu'ivla==
cimjvo are moved into fu'ivla (thus they are not-decomposable). jvajvo are taught separately.
*CVV rafsi can act only as suffixes.
*CCV rafsi can go anywhere.
*CVC rafsi are deleted ('''retsku''' is no different from fu'ivla, but '''retskugau''' has -gau suffix).

'''fu'ivla''' might get regularized suffixes specifying their semantic classes. Thus ideologically they are like rafsi-suffixes (idea by [[la selpa'i]])

'''fu'ivla''' + '''cimjvo''' = this superclass will get a new name.
